xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received an Order of Adjudication from the Deputy Commissioner of Commercial Taxes, (Audit) - 4.7, Divisional Goods and Service Tax Office - VTK-2, Bangalore under applicable provisions of the Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, read with rules therein, Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, the Integrated Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 and Goods and Services Tax (Compensation) Act, 2017.The demand is raised in relation to input tax credit reporting error in GST monthly return, denial of input tax credit on sales and promotional expenditures, valuation of Corporate guarantee services under GST Law, and denial of exemption on export of services. The Company is in the process of taking appropriate actions, including but not limited to, filing of necessary appeal with the appellate authority(s) in this regard. A Writ Petition was filed before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka against the order. The Court has admitted the Appeal and granted stay. Main hearing is pending.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The personal hearing scheduled on 12.12.2025 was attended and the matter was argued on behalf of the Company. Awaiting for final order.
